title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: S&P, Nasdaq open higher after July inflation data, earnings boost - The Economic Times
text: Dow Jones Today | US Stock Market Live: The ​S&P ​500 and the ​Nasdaq opened higher on Wednesday as investors ‌assessed ⁠largely ⁠in-line inflation data, ​while upbeat earnings from some ​AI infrastructure companies provided additional support.
